decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the telemetry channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100115 declared apparel at onboarding 155 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the apparel baseline are velocity_all at +12.0 sigma (observed 5.57 against a category baseline of 1.79), velocity_recent at +12.0 sigma (observed 7.08 against a category baseline of 1.79), slope_log_volume at +7.9 sigma (observed 0.0175 against a category baseline of 0.00196). The homepage surface presents a sports_betting interface at 0.90 confidence, against a declared category of apparel. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 2 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the telemetry channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
